assertions.name: scale_is_NOT_predicted_window_is_wide
assertions.source: 46.7% of the scanned coupling range works

description: Framing spin-orbit route to the magic numbers. DERIVED, parameter-free: the ribbon twist acts by q^Casimir and l.s is a difference of Casimirs, so the twist ratio between j = l +/- 1/2 carries the exponent 2l+1 exactly -- the standard spin-orbit l-dependence, nothing chosen. NOT derived: the strength. ln(q0)=0.10434 lands inside the window that reproduces the ladder, but that window spans 46.7% of the scanned coupling range, so membership constrains almost nothing. Shape yes, scale no. Scope (a).
caveats: Closures are the 7 largest energy gaps with false positives counted. That criterion tops out at 6 hits / 1 FP anywhere in the scan, including at couplings the literature reproduces all 7 with, so the 6/7 is a limit of the criterion and NOT a measured shortfall of the framework. Do not quote it as one.
Scope (a): a negative about the SCALE only. The 2l+1 shape result is positive and unaffected; it says the ribbon twist supplies the right l-dependence without a parameter.
